forWhat: Who teaches which class and subject, and whole counts that can be checked. A person's pages open on the classes and subjects they hold. There is no score and no ranking: the school decides what the numbers mean.
The school's classes: each one's grade, the children in it and who teaches it. The coordinator moves a child from here.
The timetable's rules for a class. Set when periods start and end, which days are blocked, which slots are fixed, and the fewest and most periods of a subject. Every change is kept with who made it.

layout.shows: Name, Role, Class, Sessions done of planned, Notes confirmed, Notes late and Lines accepted / changed / removed, grouped by role. Press a name to open that person on the right.
A button under the table. It opens a form for name, school email and role.

layout.area: Staff: A person, on the right
layout.shows: Their Grants tab: every class and subject the person holds or held: the role, the class, the subject, from and to, and who gave it. With [[Add a grant]] and, on a grant that is still open, [[End a grant]].
Grade, and a search for a class or an educator.
Class, Grade, Children and Educators. Press a class to open it on the right.

layout.area: Classes: The class, on the right
layout.shows: Its Children tab: each child's Sr. No. and name, since when, and where from, with a [[Move]] button on each row. With no class open, how many classes, children and grades the school has.
The class's Moves tab: every move of a child in or out of the class: Sr. No., from, to, who and when.

layout.area: Timetable rules: Title and main button
layout.shows: [[Block a day]], which takes you to the blocked days.

layout.area: Timetable rules: Blocked days and periods
layout.shows: Each block with its reason, and a form to add one.

layout.area: Timetable rules: Fewest and most periods
layout.shows: Each limit, how many periods are placed now, and a form to set one.
The slots the school pinned, by week and weekday, and a form to pin one.

layout.area: Timetable rules: Period times and Changes
layout.shows: Each period's name and times, and the last changes with who made them.

jobs.title: Add a member of staff
steps: Type their name, school email and role. Press [[Add and send a link]].
They get an email with a link to set their password. It works once and lasts {t:password_link.first_days} days.
Then open their name and give them their classes.

jobs.title: Give a person a class or a subject
steps: Press the person's name, then press [[Add a grant]].
Choose the role and the class. A role held for a subject also asks for the subject. Press [[Save the grant]].

It starts today. Sometimes the school's rules say no, for example a second class educator for one class. The page says so in words. Type why it should stand anyway and press [[Save the grant]] again, or change what you chose.

jobs.title: Stop a person holding a class
steps: Press the person's name, find the grant, and press [[End a grant]].
It ends today. The grant stays on the list with its dates, marked Ended, and nothing is deleted.

jobs.title: See who teaches a class
steps: Find the class in the table. [[Educators]] names who holds it today.

jobs.title: Move a child to another class
steps: Press the class. It opens on the right; press [[Move]] on the child's row.
Choose the class they go to, the Sr. No. they will have there and the date they start. Press [[Save the move]].
The child is in the new class from that date. Their answers and results stay with them, and the move is kept in the change log.

jobs.title: Block a day
steps: Pick the date, or a weekday, and say why in [[Reason]].
Press [[Block]]. Nothing will be placed on that day or period.

jobs.title: Change the most periods of a subject
steps: Under the limits, pick the subject and week or fortnight.
Type the fewest, the most, or both, then press [[Save limit]].

buttons.label: Add and send a link
buttons.does: Adds the person and emails them a link to set their password.
buttons.doesNot: Nobody types a password for them.

buttons.label: Save the grant
buttons.does: Gives the person the role on the class, from today.
buttons.doesNot: It does not change anyone else's classes, and it cannot give a role that reaches beyond a class.

buttons.label: End a grant
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete the grant: it stays on the list, marked Ended.

buttons.label: Move
buttons.does: Opens a small form for the new class, Sr. No. and date.
buttons.doesNot: It does not move anyone until you press Save the move.

buttons.label: Save the move
buttons.does: Closes the child's place in the old class, opens one in the new class and writes the change log.
buttons.doesNot: It does not delete anything the child has done.

buttons.label: Block a day
buttons.does: Takes you to the form that blocks a day or a period.
buttons.doesNot: It does not block anything by itself.

buttons.label: Block
buttons.does: Saves the block and keeps who made it.
buttons.doesNot: It does not move lessons yet.

buttons.label: Save limit
buttons.does: Saves the fewest and most for that subject.
buttons.doesNot: It does not rebuild the timetable yet.
